scope: Selected finding/repair record; separate reviewers are agents, and the trial was not blinded.

findings.initial_observation: All V0 polygon meshes lack authored normals; not an explicit B1 rule.
findings.producer_action: Producer authored uniform unit normals from intended winding and updated the generator.
findings.independent_recheck: R1 existence, validity and winding rules assess all 121615 meshes without skips.

findings.producer_action: Producer retimed DIV01 and DIVR, reshaped indicators as arrows and added a mounted role legend.
findings.independent_recheck: Six complete parcel/junction overlap intervals retain their required states; selected sampled clearances remain adequate.

findings.initial_observation: Overhead service distribution falls below the brief’s 14 m clear-height target.
findings.producer_action: Producer raised services and roof structure and extended walls/columns.
findings.independent_recheck: All 209 selected overhead meshes clear 14 m; minimum underside 14.060000420 m.

findings.initial_observation: An overhead tray obscures the saved diverter overview.
findings.producer_action: Producer moved the camera below the raised services.
findings.independent_recheck: Revised overview exposes junctions/indicators under normal scene visibility.

findings.producer_action: Producer added a floor post, base plate and fasteners.
findings.independent_recheck: Four gate poses show mounting; geometry review sampled sweep clearance at least 0.061712 m.
findings.outcome: supported within visual and selected clearance scope

findings.initial_observation: Connecting hardware omitted from the status tower.
findings.producer_action: Producer added mast extension, collars and a foot plate.
findings.independent_recheck: Mounting is visible; original stepped lamp samples remain unchanged.

findings.initial_observation: Wide film cannot resolve IDs, states or scan crossings.
findings.producer_action: Producer retained the wide film and added detailed stills and a synchronized explanation video.
findings.independent_recheck: Both films fully decode; sampled explanations are readable; all 721 supplied state rows match reopened USD.

findings.classification: producer-disclosed evidence omission confirmed by review
findings.initial_observation: GUI hierarchy/timeline and interactive performance evidence missing.
findings.producer_action: Producer recorded actual Blender GUI screenshots and completed-draw callback observations.
findings.independent_recheck: 4.53 callbacks/s orbit and 2.63 callbacks/s short playback sample; screenshots/source/logs consistent. Import timer label remains imprecise.

attribution_note: DIVR/P03 retiming is the producer’s extension of the general route-state feedback, subsequently verified independently. It was not a specific initial harness or reviewer discovery.
limits: All 24 scripted brief checks passed in V0 as well as V1.
Eight feedback items are not eight newly discovered defects.
No contact physics, exhaustive collision certificate, calibrated appearance or owner acceptance.
GUI playback observation spans only frames 0–47 and was not independently rerun.
